subject.title: fix(irc): disconnect on oversized inbound lines

question: Should an oversized inbound IRC record disconnect the account, and if so, must this PR prove or add automatic gateway reconnection before merge?
rationale: The byte bound is clearly required, but choosing permanent disconnection, supervised reconnection, or in-stream discard changes availability and compatibility policy for existing IRC users.

options.title: Disconnect and recover
options.body: Retain the protocol-error disconnect and require gateway-level proof or implementation of bounded automatic reconnection with backoff.

options.title: Discard until newline
options.body: Keep the socket open while dropping the oversized record and all bytes through the next newline, with rate-limited error reporting.

options.title: Accept terminal disconnect
options.body: Merge the current behavior as an intentional fail-closed policy where operator or process intervention may be required after malformed server input.

recommendation.title: Disconnect and recover
recommendation.body: Retain the protocol-error disconnect and require gateway-level proof or implementation of bounded automatic reconnection with backoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly routes IRC ownership to this maintainer, and the unresolved choice is specific to IRC protocol and connection lifecycle policy.
